requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished full-body painted sprite animation sheet for an adult fantasy game, sixteen successive drawings in a precise four-column four-row layout, row-major chronological order, transparent alpha background.
Input image 1: Layla's established adult character portrait, identity/costume reference. Input image 2: current sixteen-frame idle sheet, style and equipment reference ONLY; replace its excessive restless sway with one coherent restrained animation.
Character: Layla is an unmistakably adult dark elf woman, dark charcoal-gray skin, long silver-white hair, elegant long pointed ears, alluring lavender eyes, crescent forehead jewel, black embroidered lower-face veil, fitted black and violet silver-embroidered robes, purple sash, high boots, short silver sceptre with violet crescent gem. Retain her established outfit, face, proportions and silhouette.
Motion direction: she is facing RIGHT toward the enemy, three-quarter side view. A beautiful, confident, sultry battle idle: relaxed contrapposto with one hip gently settled, softly bent free knee, elegant wrist and a slightly knowing head tilt. Poised and alluring through posture and gaze. Fully clothed, non-explicit. Keep both boots planted at exactly the same positions throughout. Left hand rests softly near hip; right hand holds sceptre near her waist/side. One slow, shallow breath and tiny measured chin tilt; hair tips and cape hem settle just a little. NOT a dance, walking, sudden hip swing or windstorm. The motion amplitude is extremely restrained, only a few pixels at game size. Body proportions and head size NEVER change. Constant camera, constant character scale, constant boots baseline within each equal cell. Sixteen genuinely distinct tiny successive in-betweens: neutral through gentle inhale during frames 1-8, smoothly returning on exhale through frames 9-16. Final frame is almost identical to first for a seamless loop. Clear stable anatomy/hands, consistent weapon orientation, no staff teleporting. No detached sprite pieces or hair, no extra limbs.
Style: match established polished anime cel shading and silver linework, crisp clean contours and rich purple fabric, attractive graceful adult character rather than chibi. Same soft upper-left light in all frames. Entire body, all hair, all clothing, sceptre and feet must fit inside each cell with broad transparent gutters; character no more than 65% cell width and 82% cell height. Four by four evenly spaced cells; nothing overlaps adjacent cells. No ground shadows, text, numbers, grid lines, labels, UI, background, nudity or new equipment.
